# Dashboard 2.0

**Revision:** 2026-03-31
**Branch:** css-theme-restructure
**Minimum build:** 17584

---

## Overview

Dashboard 2.0 is a fully modular, drag-and-drop dashboard system for Domoticz. It replaces the fixed-layout classic dashboard with a flexible, personalized workspace where users can freely compose, resize, and arrange widgets to their liking.

Key characteristics:
- Grid-based layout powered by **GridStack.js**
- Per-user persistent layouts stored in the Domoticz database
- Multiple named dashboards per user
- Real-time device updates via the existing WebSocket (livesocket)
- Fully theme-aware using CSS custom properties (`--dz-*` variables)
- Responsive across screen sizes

---

## Getting Started

Navigate to the **Dashboard 2** menu item. On first visit, a starter layout is created automatically containing a Clock, Sun Info, and Activity Log widget.

### Toolbar (Compact Mode)

In view mode, a small floating pill bar appears in the top-right corner of the page. It contains:
- **Dashboard name** — click to open the switcher dropdown if multiple dashboards exist
- **Pencil icon** — enter Edit Mode

The bar fades to 50% opacity when not hovered to stay out of the way.

### Edit Mode

Press the pencil button or **Ctrl+E** to enter Edit Mode. The full toolbar appears at the top:

| Button | Action |
|--------|--------|
| Dashboard title | Click to rename inline |
| **Dashboards** | Switch between or manage dashboards |
| **Done Editing** | Save changes and exit edit mode |
| **Add Widget** | Open the widget library panel |
| **Save** | Manually save current layout |
| **Export / Import** | Open the export/import dialog |
| **Cancel** | Discard unsaved changes |

**Keyboard shortcuts:**
- `Ctrl+E` — toggle edit mode
- `Ctrl+S` — save layout
- `Escape` — exit edit mode (saves if dirty)

### Widget Library

Click **Add Widget** to open the slide-in library panel on the right. Widgets are grouped by category. Use the search box to filter. Click a widget's **+** button to add it to the grid.

### Widget Actions (Edit Mode)

Each widget shows a header bar in edit mode with:
- **Drag handle** — drag the title bar to reposition
- **Configure** (gear icon) — open widget settings
- **Duplicate** (copy icon) — clone the widget; the clone starts dragging immediately
- **Remove** (× icon) — delete the widget

Resize any widget by dragging the bottom-right corner handle.

---

## Managing Dashboards

### Multiple Dashboards

Click **Dashboards → Manage Dashboards...** to open the dashboard manager where you can:
- Create new dashboards
- Rename existing dashboards
- Set a dashboard as default
- Copy a dashboard
- Delete dashboards

### Export / Import

The **Export / Import** button opens a modal dialog with two tabs:

**Export tab:**
- *Clipboard* — generates JSON and lets you copy it to the clipboard for sharing (e.g. in forum posts)
- *Download* — downloads the dashboard as a `.json` file
- Choose to export the **current dashboard** or **all dashboards**

The exported JSON includes the Domoticz build revision (`domoticzRevision`) so recipients know the minimum version needed.

**Import tab:**
- *Clipboard* — paste JSON directly from the clipboard
- *File* — select a `.json` file from disk
- Choose to import as a **new dashboard** or **replace current**
- If the imported dashboard was created on a newer Domoticz build, a warning is shown (but import still proceeds)

## Widgets

### Clock
**Category:** Info
**Description:** Displays the current local time and date.

*No configuration required.*

Live: updates every second.

---

### Sun Info
**Category:** Info
**Description:** Shows today's sunrise and sunset times, derived from the configured location coordinates in Domoticz settings.

*No configuration required.*

---

### Weather
**Category:** Charts & Data
**Description:** Displays current weather conditions with an animated weather scene background.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Temperature device | Any Temp / Temp+Hum / Temp+Hum+Baro device |
| Wind device | A Wind type device |
| Barometer device | A Temp+Baro or Temp+Hum+Baro device |

Shows temperature, humidity, wind direction/speed, barometer pressure, and forecast string. The background animates to match the forecast: sunny, partly cloudy, cloudy, rain, heavy rain, snow, heavy snow, or night sky.

Live: updates instantly when any of the configured devices receive a WebSocket update.

---

### Stat Counter
**Category:** Charts & Data
**Description:** Displays a single large KPI number from any device — ideal for power usage, temperature, a counter value, etc.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Device | Any used device |
| Label | Optional custom label (defaults to device name) |

Live: updates instantly from WebSocket device updates (no extra HTTP request).

---

### Temperature Graph
**Category:** Charts & Data
**Description:** Highcharts spline chart showing temperature history for a sensor.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Device | Temperature / Temp+Hum type device |
| Time range | Last 24h / 7 days / Month / Year |
| Custom title | Overrides the auto-detected device name |

The device name is shown as a small title above the chart. On range change, the chart reloads. On device update, chart reloads after a 60-second debounce (historical data doesn't change more often).

---

### Energy Chart
**Category:** Charts & Data
**Description:** Highcharts column chart showing energy consumption (kWh) over time.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Device | Counter / kWh / Smart Meter type device |
| Time range | Last 24h / 7 days / Month / Year |
| Custom title | Overrides the auto-detected device name |

Values are displayed in kWh (converted from Wh). Debounced 60s chart refresh on device update.

---

### Activity Log
**Category:** System & Logs
**Description:** Shows the most recently updated devices, ordered by last update time — a live feed of what's happening in your home.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Max items | 5–50 items (default 15) |

Live: reloads on every WebSocket device update and polls every 15 seconds as fallback.

---

### System Status
**Category:** System & Logs
**Description:** Shows Domoticz version, build number, and hardware count.

*No configuration required.*

---

### Device
**Category:** Devices
**Description:** Embeds any single Domoticz device using its native widget (the same widget used in the existing dashboard). Automatically detects device type and renders the appropriate control (switch, dimmer, sensor tile, etc.).

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Device | Any device (including disabled hardware) |

In view mode the widget background is transparent so the device tile floats naturally. In edit mode the panel border is shown so you can see the widget boundary.

Live: updates instantly from WebSocket `device_update` events.

---

### Scene / Group
**Category:** Devices
**Description:** Embeds a Domoticz scene or group using its native widget — allowing one-click scene activation or group toggle.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Scene or Group | Any defined scene or group |

Live: updates from WebSocket `scene_update` events.

---

### Favorites
**Category:** Devices
**Description:** Shows all favorite devices grouped by category (Switches, Temperature, Weather, Utility), reproducing the classic dashboard tabs in a single widget.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Category filter | All / Switches & Lights / Temperature / Weather / Utility |
| Limit to room/plan | Optional plan ID to filter devices |
| Show category tabs | Toggle tab bar (default on) |
| Custom Title | Optional override |

Live: reloads on `device_update` and `scene_update` events, plus 60s polling fallback.

---

### Room / Plan
**Category:** Devices
**Description:** Shows all devices belonging to a specific Domoticz plan (room), useful for room-based dashboard sections.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Plan / Room ID | The numeric ID of the plan |
| Custom Title | Optional override |

Live: reloads on `device_update` and `scene_update` events.

---

### Quick Actions
**Category:** Custom Content
**Description:** A row of one-click buttons to trigger scenes or toggle switches — useful for frequently-used actions without navigating away.

**Configuration:**

An action list editor lets you add, reorder, and remove actions. For each action:
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Type | Device (toggle) or Scene (activate) |
| Device/Scene | Picked from a dropdown |
| Label | Button label (auto-filled from device/scene name if blank) |

Pressing a button sends the command immediately. A green flash confirms success.

---

### Text Note
**Category:** Custom Content
**Description:** Displays a custom text string with configurable background color, text color, font size, and alignment. Useful for section headers, labels, or status messages.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Content | The text to display |
| Background color | Color picker |
| Text color | Color picker |
| Font size | Slider (em) |
| Text align | Left / Center / Right |

---

### HTML Widget
**Category:** Custom Content
**Description:** Renders arbitrary HTML inside a sandboxed `<iframe>`. JavaScript executes normally within the sandbox. Full documents (`<!DOCTYPE html>`) are passed through as-is; snippets are wrapped in a minimal document automatically.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Widget Title | Optional label shown in the widget header (edit mode) |
| HTML Content | Full HTML or a snippet |

Security: `sandbox="allow-scripts"` — scripts run in isolation but cannot access the parent page.

---

### Camera Feed
**Category:** Custom Content
**Description:** Shows a live MJPEG or snapshot image from a Domoticz-configured camera.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Camera | Pick from configured cameras |

The image fills the widget via `object-fit: contain`.

---

### Remote Image
**Category:** Custom Content
**Description:** Displays a remote image from a URL. Useful for weather radar images, live maps, or any periodically-updating image.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Image URL | Full URL to the image |
| Refresh interval | 0 = no refresh, otherwise seconds |
| Object fit | Contain / Cover / Fill |

---

### IFrame Embed
**Category:** Custom Content
**Description:** Embeds any external website or web app in an iframe. Useful for embedding third-party dashboards, weather maps, or local network devices.

**Configuration:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| URL | The page to embed |
| Allow interaction | Enable pointer events (default on) |

Note: Many external sites block iframe embedding via `X-Frame-Options`. This works best with local network pages (router admin, other home automation systems, etc.).

---

## Live Updates

Dashboard 2.0 uses the existing Domoticz WebSocket connection (livesocket) for real-time updates. No page refresh is needed.

| Widget | Update method |
|--------|--------------|
| Clock | 1-second interval |
| Device | Instant — WebSocket `device_update` |
| Scene | Instant — WebSocket `scene_update` |
| Stat Counter | Instant — WebSocket `device_update` (no extra HTTP) |
| Weather | Instant — WebSocket `device_update` per sensor |
| Activity Log | Instant — WebSocket `device_update` |
| Favorites | Instant — WebSocket `device_update` / `scene_update` |
| Room / Plan | Instant — WebSocket `device_update` / `scene_update` |
| Temperature Graph | 60s debounced reload after device update |
| Energy Chart | 60s debounced reload after device update |
| Sun Info | Static (daily data) |
| Text / HTML / IFrame / Image | Static content |

---

## Technical Notes

### Architecture

- **AngularJS 1.x** with RequireJS (AMD) module loading
- **GridStack.js** for the drag/resize grid
- **Highcharts** for chart widgets
- Layouts stored in the Domoticz database via the `savedashboardlayout` / `getdashboardlayout` API
- CSS custom properties (`--dz-*`) for full theme compatibility

### Widget Development

Each widget consists of:
1. A JS file in `www/app/dashboard2/widgets/` that registers with `widgetRegistry` and defines an AngularJS directive
2. An HTML template in `www/views/dashboard2/widgets/`
3. Registration in the `define()` deps array of `Dashboard2Controller.js`

The `configSchema` array drives the settings modal automatically — supported field types: `text`, `textarea`, `number`, `boolean`, `select`, `device-picker`, `scene-picker`, `camera-picker`, `color`, `range`, `action-list`.

## Ideas for Future Widgets

The following widgets would add significant value for Domoticz users:

### High Priority

| Widget | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **P1 Smart Meter** | Dedicated widget for Dutch P1 smart meters showing gas + electricity in a compact summary with live values and today's totals |
| **Thermostat / Setpoint** | Shows current temperature vs setpoint for a heating zone, with +/- buttons to adjust the setpoint directly from the dashboard |
| **Multi-Sensor Summary** | Shows multiple sensors (e.g. all room temperatures) in a compact list/grid — like a house overview at a glance |
| **Device History Log** | On/off history timeline for a switch — shows when lights were on/off as a bar chart over 24h or 7 days |
| **Countdown Timer** | Counts down to a user-defined time/event (e.g. "Next bin collection: 2 days") with optional color thresholds |
| **Gauge Widget** | Circular/arc gauge for values like battery level, water usage, CPU load, or any numeric sensor |

### Medium Priority

| Widget | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Floor Plan Minimap** | A small clickable floor plan showing device states overlaid — links to the full floorplan view |
| **Sun Position** | Azimuth/elevation arc showing current sun position with sunrise/sunset markers — useful for solar panel owners |
| **Rain Gauge** | Dedicated rain widget with today/this week totals, animated rain indicator |
| **Wind Compass** | Animated compass rose showing current wind direction and speed |
| **Electricity Price Ticker** | For dynamic pricing (e.g. ENTSO-E / Tibber integration) showing current €/kWh and a 24h price chart |
| **Air Quality** | CO₂, PM2.5, VOC levels with color-coded thresholds (green/yellow/red) |
| **Battery Monitor** | Shows all devices with battery level below a threshold — a maintenance overview |
| **Notification Log** | Recent push notifications sent by Domoticz |

### Lower Priority / Niche

| Widget | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **MQTT Inspector** | Shows last value of a configurable MQTT topic — useful for debugging integrations |
| **Alarm Zone Status** | Overview of door/window/motion sensors grouped by zone |
| **Heatmap Calendar** | Monthly calendar heatmap (like GitHub contributions) for energy, temperature, or any daily value |
| **Scheduler Next Events** | Shows the next N scheduled events (sunrise-triggered scripts, timers, etc.) |
| **Custom Chart** | Free-form chart where the user can combine multiple sensors on one chart — e.g. temperature vs humidity vs energy usage |
| **Map Widget** | OpenStreetMap embed showing device GPS locations (presence detection, outdoor sensors) |
| **Waste Calendar** | Integration with Dutch/European waste collection APIs showing next collection date per category |
